title: The spawn guard's model refusal names every accepted reviewer form, and says round 1 and the test-author run on their role's model
why: Coordinator 17:21 CST Nov 8 (lane guard-fix-check-sonnet's pick 2); Merge after: #2296 (the spawn guard accepts a `Fix check` brief). Incident: lane merge-ready-uses-pin (#2303) had Sonnet refused for its test-author, its round 1 and its fix checks, fell back to Haiku against owner item 444 a, and #2303 now needs a fresh chain. Fix: the refusal names each accepted form (a reviewer brief whose first line is `Round 2 of 3`, `Round 3 of 3` or `Round N of 3 (fix check)`) and says that round 1 and the test-author run on their role's model. Red case: the refusal text for a Sonnet round-1 reviewer names those forms.
